visualReview.sourceEvidence: Wikimedia Commons original photographed 2016-04-05, 2370x2003 px, uploader/author Jan-Tore Egge (Vinguru), CC BY-SA 4.0. Commons labels only the broader address range Oscars gate 50–50B.
visualReview.observed: Original image depicts a red-brick and white-plaster corner building; a number 50 is visible on the right facade. Lower-level openings and a side passage are visible, but the specific former Fotogalleriet cellar entrance at 50A cannot be positively identified from the photo or its Commons caption.
visualReview.identityConclusion: Building/address range is documented; historical Fotogalleriet entrance 50A is not verified. A 2016 facade is not an image of the gallery operating there in 1977.
visualReview.verificationNeeded: Independent evidence locating the basement/entrance at Oscars gate 50A in this exact facade, such as a historical entrance image, archive floor plan, or documented address-door mapping.

researchLeads.lead: The museum explicitly lists an organizational archive for Stiftelsen Fotogalleriet (1977–1990). Archive existence is confirmed; no specific exterior photo of the 1977 Oscars gate 50A basement entrance has been located or licensed.
researchLeads.request: Ask if photographic documentary material depicts the 1977 Fotogalleriet premises or the entrance at Oscars gate 50A, and request catalog IDs, original photographer/date, pictured address-unit evidence, copy availability, and explicit public WebP reuse/attribution terms.
researchLeads.archiveNotes: Archive inventory lists Stiftelsen Fotogalleriet as accession NMFF.2003:6, ~3 linear metres. Its described content is exhibition arrangements, staff, accounts and budget, likely late 1980s to early 1990s; does not establish a 1977 entrance photograph. FFF archive (1974 onward) is a separate possible route and its inventory mentions some photographic material.

researchLeads.lead: The gallery itself confirms current visiting location at Møllergata 34. Request two different original documentary photographs if possible: exterior of the current signed entrance, and a second genuinely distinct interior/other documented gallery location photograph without clearance-problematic artworks.
researchLeads.request: Ask for two independent original files, photographer/source and capture date, exact entrance location, artwork/person clearance, redistribution and cropped/WebP derivative permission for a freely accessible History Go educational PlaceCard, and preferred credit/license wording. Do not assume publicly published website images are freely reusable.

researchOutcome: Four authentic exhibition documentation sources from Fotogalleriet 2019, 2022, 2024, and 2025 are logged as visual references only. User rule is to avoid permission requests; produce two separately generated, photorealistic illustrations and label them. No exhibition photo is licensed for local redistribution, and none is activated. Earlier photo-rights gates remain relevant ONLY to using literal source photos, not to wholly original illustrations.
